summary_en: Raman requested 200 matte visiting cards for delivery in Vijayawada and asked when artwork should be finalized. The agent explained that delivery takes 3 working days after artwork approval. Raman asked about payment and was told that orders above ₹1,000 require 50% advance payment, while lower-value orders can use cash on delivery; Raman preferred cash on delivery. He also asked about flex banners and was told their Vijayawada delivery time is 3 working days after artwork approval. The agent confirmed the visiting-card product, quantity, and delivery location were noted. Office hours were provided as Monday–Saturday, 9:30 AM–8:00 PM, with Sunday closed. Raman requested a call at 6:00 PM, and the agent noted this, although no confirmed follow-up completion was established. The agent explained that the order can be processed remotely without an office visit. Raman requested order details by email at ramesh.audit@example.invalid, but the agent said email could not be sent. Raman ended the call by saying no further information was needed and asked not to be called again; the agent acknowledged and closed the call.
next_action: Do not contact this number. The caller opted out.
objections: Email delivery of order details was not available.
notes: The customer showed purchase interest but did not explicitly confirm the order or payment. A 6:00 PM call was noted, but the customer subsequently requested not to be called again.
